comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Bf5 3. f3 Nf6 4. g4 Bg6 5. g5 Nfd7 6. h4 h5 7. Nxd5 e6 8. Nf4
comments.comment:
We take the bishop if black doesn't address the threat: (8... Nc6 9. Nxg6)
Otherwise we'll claim the center completely with e4: (8... Bd6 9. e4) (8... Bf5 9. e4) (8... Bh7 9. e4 c5 10. d5)
Note that in case of Bd6, we don't take the bishop due to: (8... Bd6 9. Nxg6?! Bg3+ 10. Kd2) which is unnecessary. [%csl Gg6,Be4][%cal Gb8c6,Gf4g6,Bg6h7,Bg6f5,Be2e4,Bf8d6]
